test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven brothers P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V were born in different years. S is younger than only 2 other brothers and neither of them is U. P is older than R but younger than U and S. R is not the youngest. U is younger than Q who is younger than T. Who is the youngest?
solution:
Given: Seven brothers P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V are born in different years.

1) S is younger than only 2 other brothers and neither of them is U.

This means S is the third oldest and U is younger than S.

T > Q > S > __ > __ > __ > __

2) P is older than R but younger than U and S.

As S is older than U and P is younger than both, P must be younger
